description: Lower-throughput but higher-fidelity Discord coding prompts intended to exercise the full coding workflow end-to-end on realistic lightweight projects.

scenarios.message: /coder: Build a lightweight fashion brand landing site with hero section, product highlights, brand story, and a contact form.
/coder: Build a small coffee shop website with menu cards, store hours, map section, and a reservation/contact area.
/coder: Build a compact event registration site with agenda, speaker cards, ticket selection, and a registration form.
/coder: Build a restaurant reservation site with menu preview, booking form, opening hours, and location details.
/coder: Build a course landing page with curriculum, instructor bio, testimonials, pricing, and signup CTA.
/coder: Build a small task tracking web app with add, edit, status toggle, and basic validation.
/coder: Build a small log summary tool that scans a folder and outputs a readable error summary report.
/coder: Build a simple invoice HTML template generator with customer info, line items, totals, and print styling.
/coder: Build a small Markdown utility that inserts or refreshes a table of contents section.
/coder: Build a small image manifest tool that scans a folder and writes manifest.json with file metadata.
